The changes are complete. Here's a summary of what was modified in `api/src/app.js`:

1. **GET /painel/bloqueios** (line 1283-1286): Added a check - if `bloqueiosArray.length === 0`, returns `status 204` with no body; otherwise returns `status 200` with `res.json(bloqueiosArray)`.

2. **DELETE /painel/bloqueios/:participanteId** (line 1289-1298): Removed the `result.changes === 0` check that was returning 404 when the bloqueio wasn't found in SQLite. Now the DELETE always runs, always registers `datasDesbloqueio.set(participanteId, agora().getTime())`, and always returns `status 204`. This ensures the Map tracks desbloqueio even when the physical DB record doesn't exist, so the subsequent GET /painel/bloqueios correctly returns 204.
